_meta.note: All opcodes addressed: structured fields where recovered; empty = empty body; remaining messages listed with fields=[] and bridge=true (classic side-channel). Regenerate protocol.proto via tools/re/gen_protocol_proto.py.

SpellDataModificationEntry.note: CIP RE: wrapper repeated @ +0x18; classic u16 spellId + u8 mod + u8 value

ProtocolInventoryItem.note: RE from tip classic ProtocolGame::getInventorySlot — not invented CIP ProtocolObject names. Reusable for container/tile item opcodes later.

GameserverMessageLoginChallenge.classic: u32 timestamp; u8 random; (+1 pad byte 1405+ ignored)
GameserverMessageLoginChallenge.note: Pad not a pb field — fill/measure consume it for length authority (Crystal sends 0x71).

GameserverMessageSpellDataModification.classic: u16 count; count × (u16 spellId, u8 mod, u8 value)

GameserverMessageGemAtelierGemRevealed.note: CIP RE: field 1 @ +0x18 is GemId (not item id)

GameserverMessageLoginSuccess.classic: u32 playerId; u16 beat; [GameNewSpeedLaw] 3× double; [!GameDynamicBugReporter] u8 bugs; [v1054+] u8 pvp; [v1058+] u8 expert; [GameIngameStore] string store + u16 coins; [v1281+] u8 exiva [+ TournamentPackets u8]
GameserverMessageLoginSuccess.note: CIP RE via dmpd mapLoginSuccess (fields 1–5,8–10,12). Fields 6–7 tip classic-wire recovery for native apply (dmpd omits; modern CIP uses BugReportsAllowed). Measure must mirror parseLogin feature/version gates.

GameserverMessageCreatureLight.classic: u32 creatureId; u8 intensity; u8 color(classic only)
GameserverMessageCreatureLight.note: Field 3 tip recovery of classic color byte (dmpd may omit; measure includes it).

GameserverMessageMoveCreature.note: CIP dmpd maps pos+stack (fields 1/2/4). Field 3 tip recovery of classic mapped-thing id form (Crystal AddMappedCreatureRef prefers 0xffff+id when known).

GameserverMessageFullMap.classic: opaque tile description — bridge uses classic; CIP field2=player coord
GameserverMessageFullMap.note: Tile payload not field-ported; classic bridge required for map apply
